Hello from

Le Biz Brands LLC

We’re building an e-commerce retail business with good supplier relationships at its heart.

Le Biz Brands buys consumer products from brands and authorized distributors for sale across leading U.S. online marketplaces. We’re based in Miami, with purchasing interests in baby and family, personal care, home and lifestyle, and toys.

We’re at the beginning of our journey, and we’re taking the time to get the foundations right: understanding the products, agreeing on where and how they can be sold, and being straightforward with the people we buy from.

If that sounds like the way you work, we’d like to meet you.
